Use this when an agreement needs to become something a person will do. Start with one action; link it to the meeting or decision that created it.


<details class="template-copy">
<summary>Open the blank copyable template</summary>

Copy this plain-text version into your approved project record. Repeat entry fields as needed and remove prompts that do not apply. The guidance and examples below help you complete it.

```text
Action register

Blank register

ID: A-001
Action: [verb + object]
Owner: [one owner]
Due: [date]
Dependency: [ID or none]
Status: queued / active / blocked / done / cancelled
Evidence of done: [observable result]
```

</details>

## Decision rules

If you need approval, access or a reply, keep the action open until it arrives. Mark it **blocked** when you cannot proceed. Give each action one named owner so everyone knows who will follow up.

## Check your record

Before marking an action done, open the promised evidence. If the action was to obtain access, an emailed request is progress, not completion.

## Scenario test

A request was emailed but access has not arrived. The action remains blocked, preventing false completion.
